credits.title: Welcome to Kurosawa House
credits.overview: Stevie and Claire enter Kurosawa House, an exclusive treatment centre for A-Listers to treat their tech and social media addiction, to discover its sinister secret.

credits.title: Love in a Hopeless Place
credits.overview: Modern dating sucks. Deidre is looking for love but she also has the luxury of feeding off them when they don't work out.

credits.title: The Killgrin
credits.overview: After a personal tragedy, Miranda explores unconventional self-help methods, only to learn from a spiritual healer that she has an infection of her aura called a 'killgrin', which thrives off her misery.

credits.title: Stealing Vows
credits.overview: Four wedding professionals kicked off an intricate crime spree after one seeks revenge on an ex. It becomes a way out of their troubled lives for a drug-addicted emcee, a gambling chef, a meek decorator, and a gifted photographer.

credits.title: The Daughter I Gave Away
credits.overview: Fifteen years after Cynthia put her daughter up for adoption, she learns that the girl has gone missing and immediately joins the search, determined to save the daughter she never knew.

credits.title: Jazz Ramsey: A K-9 Mystery
credits.overview: When Jazz Ramsey and her crime detection dog Zeus stumble upon an old crime scene, the K-9 trainer, her star pup, and ex-boyfriend and lead detective Nick are thrown into the investigation.

credits.title: Fool's Game
credits.overview: Two couples get together for a dinner party - time well spent between old friends. As time passes, secrets emerge throwing the dinner into chaos, challenging the couples' understanding of love, betrayal, monogamy, and marriage.

credits.title: A Not So Royal Christmas
credits.overview: When tabloid journalist Charlotte requests an interview with a famously private Count — not knowing he fled town years ago — the royal family convinces their groundskeeper to pose as him.

credits.title: Christmas Casanova
credits.overview: Elise is a podcaster in need of catchy Christmas content. Elise agrees to be Daniyal's wing woman and guide. As the two scramble to build the best Christmas ever, it becomes clear that Daniyal might be trying to win over the wrong woman.

credits.title: Eulogy to Us
credits.overview: A genre anthology about the dark side of dating and relationships.

credits.title: 14 Love Letters
credits.overview: After historic love letters start anonymously appearing in Kallie Sharp's mailbox, the hobby farmer searches for her secret admirer and opens herself up to love.

credits.title: It Takes a Christmas Village
credits.overview: When construction on Main Street threatens to put the town's shops out of business, mayor Alex Foster decides to throw a Christmas market to boost sales. credits.title: We
credits.overview: Dating within different cultures and being open to all religions, Ethan must deal with constant roadblocks. From First Nations to South American, his journey to find love in Toronto is nothing but complex. He faces discrimination and depression but always remains optimistic.

credits.title: Destruction Makes the World Burn Brighter
credits.overview: A young couple in the not so distant future find their secret existence threatened when reserves run low.

credits.title: Away Home
credits.overview: A man returns to his family home on the East Coast of Canada to say goodbye to his terminally ill mother.

credits.title: Beeba Boys
credits.overview: Gang leader Jeet Johar and his young, loyal, and often-brutal crew dress like peacocks, love attention, and openly compete with an old style Indo crime syndicate to take over the Vancouver drug and arms scene. credits.title: Toilet
credits.overview: A 30-something Gundam fan and engineer is forced to live with his recluse brother Maury and younger sister Lisa to take care of their Japanese grandmother after their mother's funeral.
